```{r, load packages and working directory}

# data import and database management 
# reading files, reshaping data, and efficient data handling 

#######################################################

library(readxl) # import excel spreadsheets
library(data.table) #quick manipulation of large datasets
library(stringr) # text and string processing 
library(lubridate) # data and time handling 
library(writexl) # exports editted databases into excel files

#######################################################

# General data science workflow 
# Collection of packages for data manipulation and plotting

#######################################################

library(tidyverse)

#######################################################

#Statistical analyses and mixed models 
# Hypothesis testing, summaries, and model fitting 

#######################################################

library(gt) # displaying formatted tables for statistics 
library(rstatix) # statistical tests and assumption checking
library(lmerTest) # p-values and tests for lme4 models 
library(lme4) # linear and generalized mixed-effects models
library(ggeffects) # predicted values and marginal effects 

#######################################################

# Data visualization 
# Plot creation, figure assembly, and publication formatting 

#######################################################

library(patchwork) #comvine ggplots into multi-panel figures
library(cowplot) # figure arrangement and plot annotations
library(rcartocolor) # color palettes
library(ggh4x) # advanced ggplot extensions
library(scales) # axis labels, formatting, and scaling 

#######################################################
# Spatial data and mapping 
# GIS data handling and map visualization
#######################################################

library(sf) #spatial vector data
library(ggmap) #basemaps and geographic visualization
library(ggspatial) #spatial annotations and map elements
library(leaflet) #interactive web maps

#######################################################

#Tables and report outputs 
# Interactive tables and report presentation 

#######################################################

library(reactable) #interactive tables for reports

#######################################################
# R markdown and document rendering 
# PDF generation and LaTeX support 
#######################################################

library(tinytex) #LaTeX engine for PDF knitting
```

## Including Plots

You can also embed plots, for example:

```{r, RQ1 Scarp}

#install.packages("tidytext")
library(tidytext)

site_order <- master_tier3 %>%
  distinct(Site, marsh_edge_type) %>%
  arrange(marsh_edge_type, Site) %>%
  pull(Site)

master_tier3 <- master_tier3 %>%
  mutate(Site = factor(Site, levels = site_order))

rq1_site = ggplot(master_tier3, aes(x =Site , y = log(Flux),
                                                  fill = marsh_edge_type,
                                                  color = marsh_edge_type)) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.4, outlier.shape = NA,
               alpha = 0.3,
               position = position_dodge(0.5)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = marsh_edge_type),
             position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.15, dodge.width = 0.5),
             size = 1.5, alpha = 0.3) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Ramped" = "#378ADD", "Scarped" = "#D85A30")) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Ramped" = "#378ADD", "Scarped" = "#D85A30")) +
  ylim(0, 6) +
  labs(y = "Log(Flux (g/m^2/day))", x = "Site",
       fill = "Marsh Edge Type", color = "Marsh Edge Type",
       title = str_wrap("Sediment Deposition Rates Across Sites Between Scarped and Ramped Marsh Edge Sites")) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
rq1_site

ggsave("C:\\Users\\savan\\OneDrive - San Francisco State University\\ProjectData\\GitHub\\DepositionSFB\\images\\rq1_site.png", 
       width = 8, 
       height = 5, 
       dpi = 300,
       limitsize = FALSE)

tran_order <- master_tier3 %>%
  distinct(Tran, marsh_edge_type) %>%
  arrange(marsh_edge_type, Tran) %>%
  pull(Tran)



rq1_tran = ggplot(master_tier3, aes(x =Site , y = log(Flux),
                                    fill = Tran,
                                    color = Tran)) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.4, outlier.shape = NA,
               alpha = 0.3,
               position = position_dodge(0.5)) + facet_wrap(~marsh_edge_type, scales = "free_x") +
  geom_point(aes(color = marsh_edge_type),
             position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.15, dodge.width = 0.5),
             size = 1.5, alpha = 0.3) +

  scale_color_manual(values = c("T1" = "#378ADD", "T2" = "#D85A30")) +
  scale_x_reordered() +
  ylim(0, 6) +

       fill = "Marsh Edge Type", color = "Marsh Edge Type",
```

```{r, rq1 time}

summary_df <- master_tier3 %>%
  group_by(Site, Tran, Date.removed.from.field) %>%
  summarise(median_flux = median(Flux, na.rm = TRUE),
            q25 = quantile(Flux, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
            q75 = quantile(Flux, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop")

rq1_time_trend = ggplot(summary_df, aes(x = Date.removed.from.field, y = median_flux, color = Tran, fill = Tran)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = q25, ymax = q75), alpha = 0.15, color = NA) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(size = 1.8) +
  facet_wrap(~Site, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("T1" = "#D85A30", "T2" = "#378ADD")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("T1" = "#D85A30", "T2" = "#378ADD")) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 15) +
  labs(x = "Date Removed from Field", y = expression(Median~Flux~(g/m^2/day)),
       color = "Transect", fill = "Transect") +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"))
```

```{r}

elev_z_flux_clean <- elev_z_flux |> 
  filter(Flux > 0)  # removes negatives and zeros

# Double check it worked
sum(elev_z_flux_clean$Flux <= 0, na.rm = TRUE)  # should return 0
summary(elev_z_flux_clean$Flux)


# 1. Test if slopes are significantly different between morphology types
library(lme4)
model <- lmer(log(Flux) ~ z_star * marsh_edge_type + (1|Site) + (1|Study.Phase), 
              data = elev_z_flux_clean)
summary(model)

# 1. Get p-values formally
library(lmerTest)
model_full <- lmer(log(Flux) ~ z_star * marsh_edge_type + 
                     (1 | Site) + (1 | Study.Phase),  
                   data = elev_z_flux_clean,
                   REML = FALSE)
summary(model_full)  # lmerTest will now show p-values

# 2. Calculate R-squared
library(MuMIn)
r.squaredGLMM(model_full)
# R2m = variance explained by fixed effects only
# R2c = variance explained by entire model including random effects

# 3. Get predicted slopes per edge type for reporting
library(emmeans)
emtrends(model_full, ~ marsh_edge_type, var = "z_star")


# 1. Get formal p-values for reporting
library(lmerTest)
summary(model_full)

# 2. Get R-squared values
library(MuMIn)
r.squaredGLMM(model_full)

# 3. Plot the predicted trends cleanly for a publication figure
library(ggeffects)
pred <- ggpredict(model_full, terms = c("z_star [all]", "marsh_edge_type"))

ggplot(pred, aes(x = x, y = predicted, color = group, fill = group)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = conf.low, ymax = conf.high), alpha = 0.2, color = NA) +
  geom_point(data = elev_z_flux_clean, 
             aes(x = z_star, y = log(Flux), color = marsh_edge_type),
             alpha = 0.3, size = 1.5, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Ramped" = "#E69F00", "Scarped" = "#0072B2")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values  = c("Ramped" = "#E69F00", "Scarped" = "#0072B2")) +
  labs(x = "z*", 
       y = "log(Sediment Flux g/m²)",
       color = "Edge Type", 
       fill  = "Edge Type",
       title = "Sediment Deposition by Marsh Edge Morphology") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "right")
```
